    all_rows = sorted(set(rows2_all + rows3_all))
    
    if r3_min == r2_min:
        # Same start row: horizontal at end+1
        conn_row = max(r2_max, r3_max) + 1
        for c in range(min(c2, c3), max(c2, c3) + 1):
            if conn_row < len(result):
                result[conn_row][c] = 3
    else:
        # Different start rows: vertical then horizontal at end row
        end_row = max(r2_max, r3_max)
        
        # Vertical line in the column of whichever object starts higher
        if r3_min < r2_min:
            # 3s start higher: vertical from 3s top to end_row
            for r in range(r3_min, end_row + 1):
                result[r][c3] = 3
            # Horizontal at end_row
            for c in range(min(c2, c3), max(c2, c3) + 1):
                result[end_row][c] = 3
        else:
            # 2s start higher: vertical from 2s top to end_row  
            for r in range(r2_min, end_row + 1):
                result[r][c2] = 3
            # Horizontal at end_row
            for c in range(min(c2, c3), max(c2, c3) + 1):
                result[end_row][c] = 3
    
    return result
